nodes.title: Expectation Damages and Mitigation
nodes.conceptSummary:
### 1. Pangkal Anomali
Karyawan yang dipecat secara sewenang-wenang sering kali sengaja berdiam diri di rumah dan menolak tawaran pekerjaan pengganti yang identik di kota yang sama dengan asumsi pengadilan akan memberinya gaji penuh tanpa potongan.

### 2. Prototipe Intuitif
Bayangkan sebuah perahu bocor akibat kelalaian perahu lain. Pemilik perahu berhak menuntut ongkos tambal perahu, tetapi ia tidak boleh sengaja duduk diam menonton perahu tenggelam ke dasar danau tanpa menimba air (mitigasi) lalu menuntut ganti rugi kapal selam baru.

### 3. Invarian & Operasi Inti
Invarian mutlak sistem adalah **Kewajiban Mitigasi Kerugian (Doctrine of Avoidable Consequences)**: pemulihan ganti rugi bertujuan mengembalikan posisi harapan (expectation interest), namun kerugian yang sebenarnya dapat dicegah dengan usaha wajar tidak boleh dibebankan kepada pelaku wanprestasi.

forwardPass.prompt: "Predict whether an wrongfully terminated employee who rejects an identical job in the same city can recover their full unpaid contract salary."

options.text: Recovery is reduced by the avoidable salary under the doctrine of avoidable consequences: an aggrieved party has an affirmative duty to mitigate damages with reasonable effort.
options.causalRationale: Correct: The duty to mitigate deducts losses that could have been avoided with reasonable effort.

options.text: The employee recovers 100% full salary because breach damages are designed to punish wrongful termination.
options.causalRationale: Punitive Fallacy: Contract damages are compensatory, never punitive.

options.text: The employee forfeits all remedies because rejecting an alternative job constitutes a waiver of breach claims.
options.causalRationale: Waiver Confusion: Failure to mitigate only reduces damages; it does not extinguish the breach claim itself.

forwardPass.groundTruth: "Recovery is reduced by the avoidable salary under the doctrine of avoidable consequences: an aggrieved party has an affirmative duty to mitigate damages with reasonable effort."
